scope: P1 source-authority normalization only. This classifies source roles and claim limits; it does not turn listed anchors into reviewed evidence or complete any GMUT gate.

authority_rows.supports: what the repo artifacts state and what rows exist
authority_rows.cannot_support: external scientific adequacy, empirical fit, or physical promotion

examples: canonical GMUT LaTeX v13 operation boundary
authority_rows.supports: separation between preserved canon and v462A candidate scaffold
authority_rows.cannot_support: automatic acceptance of v462A candidate terms

authority_rows.supports: wording stress tests, schema suggestions, blocker classification, and governance caution
authority_rows.cannot_support: CLI proof, publication authority, source review, or GMUT gate completion

examples: Arby path, branch, head, drift, worktree status, and Codex CLI version
Aster Vale path, branch, head, drift, worktree status, and Codex CLI version
authority_rows.supports: lane reachability and branch-local proof state
authority_rows.cannot_support: shared omega publication proof or physical validation

authority_rows.supports: future comparator routes for baseline, cosmology, Standard Model, gravitational propagation, and equivalence/fifth-force work
authority_rows.cannot_support: GMUT comparator pass or constraint clearance before claim-specific review

authority_rows.supports: research routing only after source lineage and claim mapping are recorded
authority_rows.cannot_support: recency authority, per-claim sufficiency, or completed research

normalization_rules: A source listing is not a source review.
A repo artifact can prove artifact contents, not external reality.
An advisory report can inform wording and blocker routing, not replace CLI proof.
Queued research remains queued until reviewed and cited against an exact claim.
Operational accounting ledgers are not physical conservation evidence.
Stage 20 labels must separate evidence, context, hypothesis, blocker, and advisory claims.

handoff.recommended_action: Choose one external anchor for claim-specific review or keep all anchors as context-only routes.
